SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, SUM(pgs.pts) AS total_points
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" pgs
JOIN "nba_golden"."dev"."games" g
  ON g.game_id = pgs.game_id
JOIN "nba_golden"."dev"."players" p
  ON p.player_id = pgs.player_id
WHERE g.game_date >= '2030-01-01' AND g.game_date < '2031-01-01'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 500
